title: Infer through the Anthropic strategy with a cassette
narrative: Nubble proves the Anthropic Messages backend is a first-class reason lane. Offline CI plays a cassette through the real `AnthropicStrategy` bound at story init — not a probe mock — so inference, usage, and cost events look the same as a live call.
implementation: `CliScenario.host.backend=anthropic` builds `AnthropicStrategy` + `MemoryAsyncHttpClient` against `response.json` (`/v1/messages`). `cli:infer` / `CliInferRunner` emits `core:inference` with usage and priced `core:cost`.
validation: Harness `cli` scenario `cassette_infer.yaml`: host backend anthropic, hard event_types includes core:inference/core:cost, token equals from cassette, cost_units lte.
